retrievalProfile.description: A vintage urban collage featuring a large monochrome central photograph with a stepped sequence of smaller color inset images along the bottom edge.
triggerTerms: monochrome urban background with color insets

recipe.visualDefinition: A central black-and-white photograph of a couple walking away in an urban setting, framed by a series of rectangular color photographs of varying heights that create a rising 'staircase' effect from left to right across the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochrome background vs. vibrant color insets
Stepped vertical hierarchy of secondary images
Hand-drawn script title contrasting with rigid sans-serif tracklist
Urban street depth vs. flat graphic overlays
coreInvariants: Stepped rectangular collage at the bottom

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central couple in monochrome, occupying 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The tallest color inset on the far right, depicting a brick building.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left title, move down the central figures, and follow the rising staircase of color photos to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Utilized in the upper-left and upper-right corners for typography and logos.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated monochrome (greys/blacks) for the main scene.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm reds and oranges in the primary title text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Naturalistic blues, greens, and browns within the small color photo insets.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value monochrome background allows the saturated color insets and red title to pop.

letterConstructionRules: Title features connected, fluid strokes with varying line weights
Numbers in the title are oversized and slightly irregular
Tracklist uses a clean, all-caps geometric sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'P' in the main title has an exaggerated, sweeping top loop
Hyphens between numbers are stylized as short, thick dashes

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in a clear area of the background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Hand-drawn expressive script paired with rigid, functional sans-serif for information.

preserve: The red-orange color of the title
The stepped height of the bottom images

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the casual, hand-drawn feel of the main title
Matches the heavy, functional feel of the tracklist

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, black-and-white urban street scene with a couple walking away. At the bottom, place five rectangular color photo insets that increase in height from left to right like a staircase.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large red-orange script title across the top. Place a small, boxed-in tracklist in a bold sans-serif font in the upper-left quadrant.

verificationChecks: Are the bottom photos arranged in a rising staircase pattern?
Is the title text a warm red-orange script?

mustRedesign: Avoid using the specific brand logos in the corners
Ensure the tracklist text is generic
postGenerationChecks: Check for 'staircase' alignment of bottom images
Ensure script font feels organic and not overly digital
Confirm tracklist is legible against the background
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban monochrome base + Stepped color collage footer + Hand-drawn script header = Vintage Soul Aesthetic
